question: Does the immutable current-main Duskblade cohort contain enough reproducible permanent-card-removal use, non-use, route breadth, viability and two-package separation to justify freezing exactly one removal-trigger mechanism for identity preflight?
competingOptions: freeze exactly the Duskblade removal-refinement trigger for source placement and identity preflight
close the removal-refinement trigger family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

scientificBasis.existingEvidence: Current-main already exposes three exact permanent-card-removal routes and the issue #490 response contract names them together as removalEconomy. The root-551 policy sampler independently varies removalAppetite from 4 through 28 and removalMinCopies over 1, 2 and 3, so the immutable trace can test behavioural repertoire without inventing a payoff or spending a row.
scientificBasis.differentStructuralAxis: A completed permanent deck cut is a run-economy state transition, not a combat scalar, named-card ordering rule, acquisition carrier, one-bit setup action, death chain or turn-state Energy mechanism closed by prior issue #421 decisions.
scientificBasis.cheapestDiscriminatingEvidence: Reuse the 256 explicit-current trace rows already proved exactly identical to the 256 frozen current-main baseline rows after trace labels are removed. Deterministic policy-set arithmetic is sufficient to reject a sparse, universal or package-aliased substrate.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: This is a necessary observational capacity screen. It does not identify a causal removal payoff, card, relic, exact removed-card identity, timing, effect size, package benefit, product candidate or held-out result. A pass authorises identity preflight only.

candidate.mediator: One completed permanent card removal through an existing shop, Forgotten Shrine or Mirror route.
candidate.prospectiveTrigger: A single observation-only Duskblade trigger emitted after and only after the existing removal has completed. It cannot change the removed card, price, event choice, deck, policy, RNG or result.
candidate.payoff: Absent and deliberately undefined. No numeric reward, content carrier or consumer may be chosen from this capacity result.
candidate.carrier: Unselected. A card, relic or effect carrier is outside this screen and cannot be used to rescue it.
candidate.structuralDifference: The mediator is a permanent run-level deck-curation transition whose frequency depends on route and removal policy, rather than a combat action or reward-pool package handshake.

removalRefinementTrigger.level0: Exact current-main. No new trigger exists and path, RNG, policy, state and result remain byte-identical.
removalRefinementTrigger.level1: Prospective identity-preflight level only: after an existing completed permanent removal, emit one observation-only Duskblade trigger. No payoff or state mutation is authorised.
removalRefinementTrigger.status: Fixed at level 0 in every cached row. Level 1 is authorised only if every capacity gate passes.

removalRefinementPayoff.absent: No payoff, magnitude, consumer, carrier or content definition exists.
removalRefinementPayoff.status: Separate prospective causal factor. It cannot be defined or varied by this screen.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.
scorelinePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed throughout and never bundled with Afterimage or removal.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Warden's Edge Afterimage payoff.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline and removal.

acquisitionPriority.current: Exact frozen root-551 policy identities and natural reward/economy path.

wardSetupPriority.current: Exact current/null Ward setup path; no structural intervention.

designMatrix.kind: one immutable observational cell with three prespecified mechanism routes; not a factorial
anchors: exact current-main content, policy and simulator source
designMatrix.aliasStructure: Package-event counts are whole-run aggregates: they do not reveal the removed card, removal time, later draws or whether removal caused a win. Root-551 policies vary many coordinates, so active/inactive repertoire is not a causal estimate of removalAppetite or removalMinCopies. Route RNG and opportunity are not randomised factors. These aliases can only support or reject necessary trigger capacity.
designMatrix.expansionRule: No simulator or joint cell is authorised here. A pass may add only null-identity and mediator-isolation proof. A later mechanism-blocked CRN must keep policy identities, seed identities, baseline, first-look budget, estimator and stopping rule equal. Add targeted Scoreline or Afterimage joint cells only if preregistered shared-anchor interference has measured decision value; never complete a Cartesian product for symmetry.

capacityDefinitions.exposureRow: At least one of shopVisited, forgottenShrineSeen or mirrorSeen is positive.
capacityDefinitions.activeRow: At least one of shopRemovalBought, shrineRemovalChosen or mirrorRemovalChosen is positive.
capacityDefinitions.routeExposureRow: The named route's exact exposure event is positive.
capacityDefinitions.routeActiveRow: The named route's exact use event is positive; the same-row exposure event must also be positive.
capacityDefinitions.robustOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are exposure rows.
capacityDefinitions.robustActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are active rows.
capacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows is active.
capacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows is active.
capacityDefinitions.viableRobustActivePolicy: A robust-active policy has at least one active Vow-5 row whose whole-run outcome is win.
capacityDefinitions.observedTriggerRoute: At least one policy is robust-active for the route under the same two-of-four rule.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
capacityDefinitions.afterimageRoutePolicy: At least two of four rows record positive afterimageGuardDamage.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Robust-active for removal but not active for the named package anchor.
capacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named package anchor but not robust-active for removal.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: removalRefinementTrigger x removalRefinementPayoff, because a future payoff can occur only after a completed removal
removal route x removalRefinementTrigger, because shop and event routes reach the same mediator through different opportunity and choice paths
removal refinement x package acquisition/use, because permanent deck thinning can change later draw frequency for either package
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.scorelineInterference: Scoreline payoff remains fixed and separate. Exact policy overlap is only a shared-anchor screen; it is not an interaction estimate.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.afterimageInterference: Afterimage payoff remains fixed and separate. Exact policy overlap is only a shared-anchor screen; it is not an interaction estimate.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.routeAlias: The three routes are mechanism blocks, not independently varied factor levels. Their counts cannot be summed as independent trials.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: Source and cached path evidence may advance to identity-safe mediator telemetry. No payoff or whole-run endpoint can be claimed until every causal contrast evaluates it on the same frozen cohort.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: Every explicit-current row must equal its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result exactly after trace and arm-label fields are removed before any removal count is read.

cohort.identity: Removal, all three routes, viability and both package anchors reuse the exact complete first-look rectangle. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

scoreline.definition: Chisel precedes a later Faultline in the same fight in at least two of four rows.

afterimage.definition: Positive afterimageGuardDamage is recorded in at least two of four rows.

estimands.unit: Frozen policy identity with the preregistered two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.primary: Exact robust-opportunity, robust-active, exact-inactive and ambiguous removal policy counts and identities.
estimands.routeBreadth: For each prespecified route, exact robust-exposure and robust-active policy counts and identities; number and identity of routes with at least one robust-active policy.
estimands.viability: Exact robust-active policies with at least one active winning Vow-5 row.
estimands.separation: Separate exact candidate-only, anchor-only, overlap and Jaccard policy-set statistics against Scoreline and Afterimage.
estimands.reliability: Exact cached stall/error rows under the immutable current arm.
estimands.notEstimated: No causal payoff, removal-policy main effect, removed-card identity, timing, future draw, carrier, content definition, package interaction, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected seed or product endpoint is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic immutable-source assertions, exact cache identity, exact event predicates and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One prespecified trigger substrate, all three source-defined routes, one immutable cohort and one complete first look. No event, route, threshold, anchor, policy or seed may change after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Freeze exactly the one trigger mechanism only if every gate passes; otherwise close this family, or record inconclusive only when deterministic execution exceeds the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive/opportunity and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy scale. Two independently observed source routes prevent a shop-only alias; a route must itself be robust for at least one policy. Both packages retain the frozen 0.75 Jaccard ceiling, and one fault is the immutable cached baseline.

decisionRules.success: Opportunity, active, inactive, viability, route-breadth, separate Scoreline/Afterimage separation, source identity, cache identity, event integrity and reliability gates all pass.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze exactly duskblade-removal-refinement-trigger as the sole feasible mechanism for source-placement and identity preflight. Implement no payoff or content. First prove omitted/level-0 exact path, RNG, policy, state and result identity across all 256 rows, then prove on focused controls that level 1 emits only after one completed existing removal and changes no simulation state. Only a later preregistration may define a payoff or spend a simulator row.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the complete removal-refinement trigger family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not subset routes, weaken robustness, tune removal policy, invent a payoff, add a carrier or rerun this cohort.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Current-main source, immutable cache or deterministic decision cannot complete before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, trace extension, payoff, carrier, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source validation, cache identity, candidate construction, route classification, both package comparisons and stop/go. Issue #524 and #525 are immutable scientific evidence only and are not reconstructed. No model context, human label, optimiser, ML, RL or adaptive candidate iteration enters execution.

balancePilot: return copies >= removal_min_copies and wscore <= removal_appetite - REMOVAL_SHOP_MARGIN
